title: Can LLMs Recognize Toxicity? A Structured Investigation Framework and Toxicity Metric
findings: The paper's findings related to religion fall under the broader category of demographic bias. It was found that all tested Large Language Models (LLMs) are generally well aware of demographic biases, including religious stereotypes, even without few-shot examples. They could successfully navigate ambiguous scenarios involving religious groups (Mormon and Muslim) by choosing the neutral/unbiased answer in a multiple-choice setting.
